provenance.galleryTitle: Four comparisons — fitting the separate events
galleryIntro: Four sounds you just judged: book flip and coin, plus attack and bell controls.
Compare a native Stackr timeline, the same components starting together, and your exact earlier choice. Identical options are merged.
Existing inverse models fit individual events; no neural weights were retrained. Repeated development cases, including historical Bfxr overlap. Choose the closest, then how close.
provenance.scope: Four repeated external references, including two prior similar controls. Frozen existing shared22 and Transfxr mixture experts; no neural retraining. Segment-conditioned proposals and actual native Stackr. Historical Bfxr overlap; no generalization or equal-baseline-budget claim.
provenance.selectionPolicy: All four preselected rows, even score regressions. Final scheduled stack, exact same components with zero starts, exact previous human winner. Deduplicate exact PCM with role aliases.

likeness.meaning: Likeness to reference: 1 = far off, 5 = very close

usefulness.meaning: Useful/fun game sound: 1 = not useful, 5 = very useful or fun
